verseText: Jesus replied, “Truly, truly, I tell you, no one can see the kingdom of God unless he is born again.”
meaning: Our spirits (or souls) are born dead in sin. In order to believe and join God's kingdom, we need God's Spirit to bring our spirits to life.

recall.question: What does Jesus say must happen before someone can see God's kingdom?

meaning.question: Being “born again” doesn't mean becoming a baby again! What does Jesus mean?
choices: God gives us new spiritual life
We start our lives all over

application.prompt: When you were born, you received physical life. But Jesus says we also need new spiritual life, which only God can give us! You can't earn this new life by being good enough. Ask God's Holy Spirit to give you a new heart that loves Jesus and trusts Him.
